## Acceptance batch 5 salvage — 2026-11-12

**Status: salvage — six exact PASS nodes in six standalone cases.** Latest editorial evidence is [review 2](question-topic-pediatric-neck-thoracic-gu-review2-20261111.json), SHA-256 b7ca6ac4c925f062868c30b0ac6c70ee3e5aeb20a2945a0e6926fce8954f580c. [Batch 5](question-topic-acceptance-batch5-20261111.md) skipped all six for runtime identity, prospective choice timing or mixed composition. This repair preserves every complete scored question and node object, including task, current update, exhibit, choice meanings/order/key, rationales, feedback and terminal metadata. No new question or concept version is created.

Each named child now attends the existing clinic with the exact authored parent, one explicit outpatient pediatric profile, compatible demographics and a verified child still. Current six-year-old Isla Chen reviews her recorded four-day-old neonatal ICU episode with Mei Chen; the historical infant age and all ICU decision data remain unchanged. Other current child ages and all parent identities remain the same. New wrappers are presentation salvage and remain needs_clinician_review.

All six choices concern the outside-record decision. Their runtime classification is `no_test`, with null services and result gates. Nine former prospective testing-choice proposals remain historical; they are not clinic orders. No test, operation, anesthesia, ICU treatment or hospital care is enacted here.
